ruleDefinitions.name: New ODBC Driver Registered
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the registration of a new ODBC driver. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\ODBC\\\\ODBCINST\\\.INI\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Driver$")) AND  NOT ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SQL\\ Server\\\\.*") AND Details = "\%WINDIR\%\\System32\\SQLSRV32\.dll")) AND  NOT ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Access\\ .*") AND Details = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Progra") AND Details = RGX("\\\\ACEODBC\\\.DLL$")) OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Excel\\ Driver.*") AND Details = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Progra") AND Details = RGX("\\\\ACEODBC\\\.DLL$")))
